title: Something Sat At The End Of My Bed At 3 A.M. #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you wake up at 3 a.m. and you can't move.
Not your arms. Not your legs. Only your eyes.
Something is sitting at the end of your bed.
The mattress sinks where it sits.
It's turned away from you. Very still.
You try to scream. Nothing comes out.
*Slowly, it starts to turn its head.
Then your alarm rings. You can move. The room is empty.
Then you see the dent at the end of the bed. Still there.
Would you check under the bed, or leave the room? Comment A or B.
